For the three months ended June&#160;30, 2026, these costs are employee termination benefit costs including change-in-control payments to former management and retention payments of $14.3 million, accelerated stock compensation expense and related costs of $12.5 million and certain transaction related costs of $1.3 million. For the</span><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%"> </span>six months ended June&#160;30, 2026, these costs are employee termination benefit costs including change-in-control payments to former management and retention payments of $14.3 million, accelerated stock compensation expense and related costs of $12.5 million and certain transaction related costs of $2.7 million.<span></span>
